summary: IDEAYA Biosciences replaced an expiring shelf registration statement (Form S-3ASR) and filed a prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $156.6 million in common stock under an existing sales agreement with Jefferies. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special event is present. The filing simply updates the registration vehicle for continued ordinary-course equity sales.
